title: Kava launches USDX minting
description: Kava's public lending launch enabled BNB collateral and USDX minting.
notes: Day-level boundary follows Kava Labs' dated announcement.

title: Beanstalk deploys Bean
description: Beanstalk and the first Bean token were deployed on Ethereum.

title: Governance exploit pauses Beanstalk
description: A governance exploit caused major asset losses and paused the protocol.
notes: The protocol later replanted; the incident remains within the same Bean identity.

title: Beanstalk Replant restores operation
description: Beanstalk completed its Replant and resumed protocol operation with recapitalization mechanics.
notes: Replant is treated as recovery within the same Bean identity.

title: BIP-50 migrates Beanstalk to Arbitrum
description: Beanstalk migrated from Ethereum mainnet to Arbitrum One and replaced the earlier token lineage with the current Arbitrum token.
notes: The stablecoin remains one continuing protocol identity.
